title: Try crate-jmap's jmap-server i18n (language/localizations) in place of mimid's own src/jmap/language.rs
description: Split from mimid-1wgh.11.10 (crate-jmap pin now 83a08405, which has the i18n work). See whether jmap-server's language argument and localizations handling can replace mimid-server's src/jmap/language.rs (Chat only), keeping mimid's Chat name/description mapping from RoomMetaData.
close_reason: Switched: crate-jmap jmap-server i18n (I18nProjection, handle_query[_changes]_with_i18n, LanguageTag) replaces mimid's language argument/Lookup/view; mimid keeps the RoomMetaData mapping. Differences in decision mimid-1wgh.70. Commit 082a491 on js-lang. crate-jmap gap: jmap_chat_types::Chat declares no JmapObject::LOCALIZABLE (mimid declares it on ChatRecord).
